documentation.subject: Fixture classifier: more than 20% of /classify requests are failing
documentation.content:
More than 20% of `/classify` requests to Cloud Run service `fixture-classifier` failed over the last 10 minutes (at least 3 requests). Failed requests return 502/503/500 and never a label.

See which errors (`jsonPayload.error_type`: rate_limited, api_error, unreachable, invalid_answer, ...) in Logs Explorer with:

```
resource.type="cloud_run_revision"
resource.labels.service_name="fixture-classifier"
jsonPayload.event="classify"
jsonPayload.outcome="error"
```

Dashboard: Monitoring > Dashboards > Fixture classifier. Runbook: src/classifier/README.md, "Monitoring".
